      "status": "done",

      ],
      "description": "Add optional member=False to storefront.preview(lines). Put the discount policy (10% of subtotal floored, capped at 2000 cents per order) in a pricing helper that checkout will reuse in T-2; calculate_total stays gross. Keep the three-key result, empty-all-zero and invalid-line ValueError. Add tests for member boundaries, cap, floor, repeated SKUs, empty, invalid lines, default/explicit False, and that calculate_total/export_subtotal stay gross.",

        "src/storeflow/storefront.py",
        "tests/test_member_preview.py"
      ],

        "tests/test_existing.py"

      "test_evidence": "python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v (Python 3.9.6): Ran 16 tests OK on base 93bc254 + uncommitted T-1 working tree; impact digest equal before/after run; new tests in tests/test_member_preview.py (MemberPreviewTests 8, PreserveWithPreviewTests 1) plus 7 unchanged ExistingTests; red run before implementation: 9 errors (TypeError unexpected keyword 'member')"
    },
    {
      "id": "T-2",
      "title": "Member charge and idempotent receipts in Checkout.place_order",

      "allowed_paths": [
        "src/storeflow/checkout.py",

      ],

        "tests/test_member_checkout.py",

      ],
      "depends_on": [

      ]

    {

      "title": "Atomic failure handling for place_order",
      "status": "planned",
      "requirement_ids": [
        "R-ATOMIC"
      ],
      "description": "Validate lines and aggregated stock (repeated SKUs combined) before mutating; on payment decline restore reserved stock and leave charges/receipt cache unchanged (decline_next may be consumed); a retry with the same request ID can then succeed once; empty order still raises ValueError.",
      "allowed_paths": [
        "src/storeflow/checkout.py",
        "src/storeflow/inventory.py",

      "planned_tests": [

      ]

            "Membership input is a boolean parameter."

            "Repeating a successful request ID returns the same original receipt object, even if the later lines or member flag differ or are invalid.",

            "Membership input is a boolean parameter."
          ],
          "assumptions": []
        },

          "id": "R-ATOMIC",
          "title": "Atomic failed checkout attempts",
          "statement": "When place_order fails in validation, stock or payment, stock, ledger charges and the receipt cache remain exactly as before the attempt.",

          "acceptance_criteria": [
            "A validation failure leaves stock, ledger charges and receipt cache unchanged.",
            "An insufficient-stock failure leaves stock, ledger charges and receipt cache unchanged.",
            "A declined payment leaves stock, ledger charges and receipt cache unchanged; it may consume the simulator decline_next flag.",
            "After a declined attempt, a later retry with the same request ID can succeed once.",
            "Stock validation accounts for repeated SKU entries by their combined quantity.",
            "An empty order still raises ValueError."
          ],
          "assumptions": []
        },
